# Page One Singapore

> Page One Singapore helps Singapore businesses get found on Google Search, Google Maps and AI assistants (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity). Monthly subscription, no setup fee, no contract.

## Services
- Get Found (basic subscription), S$20/month: a new website on the client's own domain (for businesses without a website), or an SEO landing page on a subdomain (for businesses that already have a website). Includes Google Business Profile setup, Google Search Console and Bing setup, structured data for AI search, hosting, SSL and a WhatsApp button.
- SEO Boost, S$10 each (optional top-up): one improvement round for faster results, covering Google and AI visibility checks, improvements made, and a before/after report. Clients top up anytime, as many or as few as they like.

## Terms
- No setup fee, no minimum contract, cancel anytime.
- Sign up and top up via WhatsApp.
- Clients own their domain.
- Rankings are not guaranteed; every SEO Boost is documented in a report.

## Websites we run
- [SG Garage](https://sggarage.com/): car servicing and repair workshop
- [Cleanic Detailing](https://cleanicdetailing.com/): car grooming and interior cleaning
- [SofaCare SG](https://sofacaresg.com/): sofa, mattress and upholstery cleaning
- [Alicia Ong Property](https://aliciaongproperty.com/): property buying, selling and rental
- [Danny Chua Financial](https://dannychuafinancial.com/): financial planning and insurance

## Area served
Singapore, island-wide
